controles.affirmation: Teledyne a fait des DEMANDES DE RENSEIGNEMENTS volontaires ('voluntary disclosures') aupres du Departement d'Etat et du Departement du Commerce
controles.verbatim_source: We have made other voluntary disclosures to the U.S. Department of State and the U.S. Department of Commerce, including to the Bureau of Industry and Security ('BIS') with respect to Teledyne FLIR shipments of products from non-U.S. jurisdictions which were not licensed due to incorrect de minimis calculation methodology under the Export Administration Regulations. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A)
controles.correction_proposee: Une 'voluntary disclosure' est un SIGNALEMENT volontaire par lequel l'entreprise declare elle-meme a l'autorite une possible infraction, pas une demande de renseignements. Ecrire : 'Teledyne a effectue des signalements volontaires (voluntary disclosures) aupres du Departement d'Etat et du Departement du Commerce'. Le glossaire de l'ATT definit d'ailleurs correctement le terme, en contradiction avec le texte de l'argument.

controles.affirmation: Une issue defavorable pourrait entrainer des amendes substantielles ou une suspension de privileges d'exportation
controles.verbatim_source: An unfavorable outcome could result in substantial fines and penalties or loss or suspension of export privileges or of particular authorizations that could be material to our financial position, results of operations or cash flows. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: L'accord de consentement historique avec le Departement d'Etat a ete clos en avril 2022
controles.verbatim_source: Effective April 24, 2022, the United States Department of State's Office of Defense Trade Controls Compliance ('DDTC') closed the four-year Consent Agreement that had been entered into by FLIR Systems, Inc., to resolve various export allegations under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations ('ITAR'). (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: La dette totale NETTE s'eleve a 2 027,0 M$ pour 340,1 M$ de tresorerie (ratio de couverture 16,8%)
controles.verbatim_source: Total debt, net of unamortized debt discount and debt issuance costs at June 28, 2026, was $2,027.0 million compared with $2,475.4 million at December 28, 2025. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: 'Total debt, net' signifie ici dette totale NETTE DES FRAIS D'EMISSION ET DE LA DECOTE, pas dette nette de tresorerie. En francais 'dette nette' designe la dette moins la tresorerie, soit 1 686,9 M$ ici. Ecrire 'dette brute de 2 027,0 M$ (nette des frais d'emission)' ou 'dette nette de tresorerie de 1 686,9 M$'. Idem dans le bloc quantitatif.

controles.affirmation: Dette en baisse de 22,5% en un an apres remboursement de 450 M$ de Senior Notes echeance avril 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Total debt, net ... at June 29, 2025, was $2,617.4 million (10-Q T2 2025) vs $2,027.0 million au 28/06/2026 = -22,56%. '1.60 % Fixed Rate Senior Notes due April 2026 | - | 450.0' et 'In the second quarter of 2026, the Company repaid $450 [million]' (10-Q T2 2026).

controles.affirmation: Le 10 aout 2026, accord de fusion definitif pour racheter Varex Imaging via Detect Merger Sub, transaction integralement en numeraire
controles.verbatim_source: On August 10, 2026, Teledyne Technologies Incorporated ... and Varex ... have executed a definitive merger agreement ... pursuant to which the Company agreed to acquire Varex in an all-cash transaction (8-K du 10/08/2026, Item 7.01)

controles.affirmation: Tresorerie 340,1 M$ au 28 juin 2026 (vs 352,4 M$ au 28 decembre 2025)
Goodwill 8 661,9 M$ sur 15 280,4 M$ d'actifs, soit 56,7% du bilan
Impairment de trademark de 52,5 M$ en 2024 sur Digital Imaging et Instrumentation, aucun montant comparable en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: we recorded $52.5 million of pretax, non-cash trademark impairments in 2024 in the Digital Imaging and Instrumentation segments, and no comparable amounts were recorded in 2025 (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: 81% des contrats gouvernementaux etaient a prix fixe en 2025 contre 78% en 2024
controles.verbatim_source: In 2025, approximately 81% of our U.S. Government prime contracts and subcontracts were fixed-price type contracts, compared with 78% in 2024 (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: 25,4% du CA du T2 2026 provient du gouvernement americain ; 49,2% du CA provient de l'international
controles.verbatim_source: T2 2026, Customer Type : U.S. Govt. Total $421.9 sur $1,662.5 = 25,38%. Geographic Region : United States $844.4 sur $1,662.5, donc international = 818,1/1662,5 = 49,21% (10-Q T2 2026, Note 4).

controles.affirmation: Deux entites Teledyne sur l'Unreliable Entity List chinoise, affectant des filiales meme non listees
controles.verbatim_source: China has also increased sanctions on certain specific U.S. companies, including two Teledyne legal entities, by adding them to its Unreliable Entity List or Export Control List, which has impacted the ability of some Teledyne subsidiaries (including those not so listed) to conduct business in China. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Restrictions chinoises sur gallium, germanium et aimants permanents, avec impact deja constate sur la production et les prix
controles.verbatim_source: China has unveiled restrictions on exports from China of certain materials and components, including gallium and germanium and which are used in semiconductor manufacturing and permanent magnets and which have impacted the production and pricing of some of our digital imaging and aerospace and defense products. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A). Le verbatim cite en preuve est lui aussi exact : 'China has also restricted the export of certain rare earth minerals and permanent magnets that are used in our products, which has in the past delayed and could in the future limit our ability to sell products' (meme Item 1A).

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle Instrumentation 26,1% au T2 2026, -1,5 pt sur un an ; autres segments en hausse (DI +4,1 pt, ADE +0,8 pt, ES +1,6 pt)
controles.verbatim_source: T2 2026 : Instrumentation net sales 387.8, segment operating income 101.4 = 26,15%. T2 2025 : 367.6 / 101.6 = 27,64%, soit -1,49 pt. DI 19,59% vs 15,51% = +4,08 pt. ADE 26,01% vs 25,15% = +0,86 pt (l'ATT ecrit +0,8, arrondi bas). ES 12,63% vs 10,97% = +1,66 pt (l'ATT ecrit +1,6, arrondi bas). Ecarts d'arrondi non materiels. (10-Q T2 2026, note segments)

controles.affirmation: Carnet de commandes record de 5,18 Mds $, +16,4%
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 28, 2026, the aggregate amount of the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $5,176.1 million (10-Q T2 2026) ; As of June 29, 2025 ... was $4,452.8 million (10-Q T2 2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant 5,18 Mds$ est exact mais la variation reelle est de +16,2% (5176,1/4452,8), pas +16,4%. Ecart mineur, corriger en +16,2%. Figure dans 'ce_qui_affaiblirait', pas en une.
